02 — Toolchain

What I build with

Depth over breadth — one core stack, worked consistently across four shipped projects.

Rust

Primary language

Systems-level backend work — memory safety without a GC, used across every serious backend project.

Axum

Web framework

REST APIs, middleware, extractors — the framework behind the IAM platform and History Guesser.

PostgreSQL

Database

Relational modeling for auth chains, sessions, and game state — always paired with SQLx.

SQLx

Async SQL toolkit

Compile-time checked queries against Postgres, no ORM magic in the way.

Java

Secondary language

Backing the multiplayer server project — kept off the résumé until there was a repo to prove it.

Docker

Local dev & deploy

Compose setups for local development; Railway + Netlify for shipped deployments.
